=> {
  const read = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
  const resources = read('unitex-offline-resources');
  const urls = [];
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const assetPattern = /__UNITEX_ASSET_(\d+)__/g;
  const mainTitle = document.title;
  let child = null;
  let frame = null;
  let active = null;
  let position = null;
  let started = false;
  let observedURL = '';
  const langOf = url => url.searchParams.get('lang') === 'zh' ? 'zh' : 'en';
  const here = () => new URL(location.href);
  const currentLang = () => root.dataset.lang;
  const mainSection = () => here().hash.startsWith('#factory/') ? '#home' : here().hash;
  const routeOf = url => {
    const [, factory, section] = url.hash.match(/^#factory\/([a-z-]+)(\/.*)?$/) || [];
    return Object.hasOwn(documents, factory) ? { factory, section: section ? '#' + section.slice(1) : '' } : null;
  };

  const base85Alphabet = '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz!#$%&()*+-;:=>?@^_`{|}~';
  const base85Digits = Uint8Array.from({ length: 128 }, (_, code) => base85Alphabet.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(code)));
  function unpackBase85(encoded) {
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(Math.floor(encoded.length * 4 / 5));
    for (let input = 0, output = 0; input < encoded.length; output += 4) {
      let word = 0;
      for (let digit = 0; digit < 5; digit++, input++) {
        word = word * 85 + (input < encoded.length ? base85Digits[encoded.charCodeAt(input)] : 84);
      }
      bytes[output] = word >>> 24;
      bytes[output + 1] = word >>> 16;
      bytes[output + 2] = word >>> 8;
      bytes[output + 3] = word;
    }
    return bytes;
  }
  // Base91 holds the original image bytes in fewer printable characters.
  // Exclude quote, backslash and "<" to keep the inline JSON and HTML safe.
  const base91Alphabet = Array.from({ length: 94 }, (_, index) => String.fromCharCode(33 + index))
    .filter(character => character !== '"' && character !== '\\' && character !== '<').join('');
  const base91Digits = Uint8Array.from({ length: 128 }, (_, code) => base91Alphabet.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(code)));
  function unpackBase91(encoded) {
    const output = new Uint8Array(Math.ceil(encoded.length * 7 / 8));
    let offset = 0;
    let buffer = 0;
    let bits = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < encoded.length; index += 2) {
      const first = base91Digits[encoded.charCodeAt(index)];
      if (index + 1 === encoded.length) {
        output[offset++] = (buffer | (first << bits)) & 255;
        break;
      }
      const pair = first + 91 * base91Digits[encoded.charCodeAt(index + 1)];
      buffer |= pair << bits;
      bits += (pair & 8191) > 88 ? 13 : 14;
      while (bits >= 8) {
        output[offset++] = buffer & 255;
        buffer >>>= 8;
        bits -= 8;
      }
    }
    return output.subarray(0, offset);
  }

  const packedFactories = read('unitex-offline-factories');
  const documents = JSON.parse(window.pako.inflate(unpackBase85(packedFactories), { to: 'string' }));
  function hydrate(content) {
    return content.replace(assetPattern, (_, id) => {
      if (!urls[id]) {
        const uri = resources[id];
        const delimiter = uri.indexOf(',');
        const type = uri.slice(0, delimiter);
        const encoded = uri.slice(delimiter + 1);
        const bytes = type.endsWith(';base91')
          ? unpackBase91(encoded)
          : type.endsWith(';base85')
            ? unpackBase85(encoded)
            : Uint8Array.from(atob(encoded), character => character.charCodeAt(0));
        urls[id] = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: type.slice(5, -7) }));
      }
      return urls[id];
    });
  }

  function hydrateMain() {
    document.querySelectorAll('style[data-unitex-assets]').forEach(style => {
      style.textContent = hydrate(style.textContent);
      style.removeAttribute('type');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-unitex-src]').forEach(image => {
      image.src = hydrate(image.dataset.unitexSrc);
    });
  }

  function sameFileURL(hash, lang = currentLang()) {
    const url = here();
    url.searchParams.set('lang', lang);
    url.hash = hash;
    return url;
  }

  function go(hash, lang = currentLang()) {
    const next = sameFileURL(hash, lang);
    if (!active && routeOf(next)) {
      position = { hash: here().hash, y: window.scrollY };
      history.replaceState({ ...history.state, scroll: position }, '', location.href);
    }
    if (next.href !== location.href) history.pushState({}, '', next);
    render('navigate');
  }

  function syncLinks(doc, lang) {
    doc.querySelectorAll('a[data-local]').forEach(link => {
      if (!link.hasAttribute('data-unitex-route')) {
        link.setAttribute('data-unitex-route', link.getAttribute('href'));
      }
      link.setAttribute('href', sameFileURL(link.getAttribute('data-unitex-route'), lang).href);
      if (doc !== document) link.setAttribute('target', '_top');
    });
  }

  function captureLinks(doc) {
    doc.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const link = event.target.closest('a[data-unitex-route]');
      if (!link || event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      go(link.getAttribute('data-unitex-route'), doc.documentElement.dataset.lang);
    }, true);
  }

  function updateLanguage(lang) {
    if (!started) return;
    const url = sameFileURL(here().hash, lang);
    if (url.href !== location.href) history.replaceState(history.state, '', url);
    observedURL = location.href;
    if (currentLang() !== lang) api.setLanguage(lang);
  }

  function bootstrapFactory(view) {
    if (!frame || frame.contentWindow !== view) return;
    const factoryDocument = view.document;
    const api = {
      initialLanguage: () => langOf(here()),
      initialSection: () => active?.section || '',
      goToSection: hash => go('#factory/' + active.factory + '/' + hash.slice(1), factoryDocument.documentElement.dataset.lang),
      languageChanged(lang) {
        syncLinks(factoryDocument, lang);
        updateLanguage(lang);
      },
    };
    view.UnitexOffline = api;
    child = api;
    captureLinks(factoryDocument);
  }

  function showFactory(route, lang, change) {
    const ready = active?.factory === route.factory && frame;
    const previousSection = active?.section;
    active = route;
    if (ready) {
      if (frame.contentDocument?.documentElement.dataset.lang !== lang) child?.setLanguage?.(lang);
      if (previousSection !== route.section || change === 'navigate') child?.showSection?.(route.section);
      return;
    }
    document.querySelector('#main-menu[open]')?.close();
    document.querySelector('#image-dialog[open]')?.close();
    frame?.remove();
    root.dataset.offlineFactory = route.factory;
    frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    frame.id = 'unitex-offline-frame';
    const rawTitle = documents[route.factory].match(/<title>(.*?)<\/title>/s)?.[1] || mainTitle; const title = new DOMParser().parseFromString('<title>' + rawTitle + '</title>', 'text/html').title;
    frame.title = title;
    const section = '<script>parent.UnitexOffline.bootstrapFactory(window);<\/script>';
    frame.srcdoc = hydrate(documents[route.factory]).replace('</head>', section + '</head>');
    document.body.append(frame);
    document.title = title;
  }

  function render(change) {
    const url = here();
    observedURL = url.href;
    const lang = langOf(url);
    if (lang !== currentLang()) api.setLanguage(lang);
    const route = routeOf(url);
    if (route) {
      showFactory(route, lang, change);
      return;

  }

  function handleHistory() {
    if (location.href !== observedURL) render('history');
  }

  const api = {
    hydrateMain,
    bootstrapFactory,
    mainSection,
    initialLanguage: () => langOf(here()),
    languageChanged(lang) {
      syncLinks(document, lang);
      updateLanguage(lang);
    },
    start() {
      started = true;
      captureLinks(document);
      window.addEventListener('popstate', handleHistory);
      window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHistory);
      render('initialize');
    },
  };
  window.UnitexOffline = api;

Select the active filter again to clear it.</span><span class="zh">此类别暂无符合当前筛选的产品图片。再次点击已选筛选项即可清除筛选。</span></p><button type="button" class="btn p238-more" data-p238-more><span class="en">Load more</span><span class="zh">加载更多</span></button></div></div></section><script>(() => {
  const view = document.getElementById('products-view');
  const categories = [...view.querySelectorAll('[data-p238-category]')];
  const types = [...view.querySelectorAll('[data-p238-type]')];
  const library = view.querySelector('#product-library');
  const title = library.querySelector('[data-p238-title]');
  const allTitle = title.innerHTML;
  const back = library.querySelector('[data-p238-back]');
  const more = library.querySelector('[data-p238-more]');
  const empty = library.querySelector('[data-p238-zero]');
  const products = [...library.querySelectorAll('[data-p238-item]')];
  const pageSize = 24;
  let structure = '';
  let category = '';
  let limit = pageSize;

  function matchesStructure(card) {
    return !structure || card.dataset.p238Structure === structure;
  }

  function matches(card) {
    return matchesStructure(card) && (!category || card.dataset.p238CategoryId === category);
  }

  function render() {
    types.forEach(button => button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.p238Type === structure)));
    categories.forEach(button => {
      const key = button.dataset.p238Category;
      const count = products.filter(card => card.dataset.p238CategoryId === key && matchesStructure(card)).length;
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(key === category));
      button.querySelector('[data-p238-count]').textContent = count;
      button.querySelector('[data-p238-photo-label] .en').textContent = count === 1 ? 'product image' : 'product images';
    });
    const active = categories.find(button => button.dataset.p238Category === category);
    title.innerHTML = active ? active.querySelector('h3').innerHTML : allTitle;
    back.hidden = !active;

    const matchedProducts = products.filter(matches);
    const visibleProducts = new Set(matchedProducts.slice(0, limit));
    products.forEach(card => { card.hidden = !visibleProducts.has(card); });
    library.querySelector('[data-p238-visible]').textContent = visibleProducts.size;
    library.querySelector('[data-p238-total]').textContent = matchedProducts.length;
    library.querySelector('[data-p238-unit] .en').textContent = matchedProducts.length === 1 ? 'product image' : 'product images';
    more.hidden = visibleProducts.size >= matchedProducts.length;
    empty.hidden = matchedProducts.length > 0;

  }

  types.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    structure = structure === button.dataset.p238Type ? '' : button.dataset.p238Type;
    limit = pageSize;
    render();
  }));
  categories.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    category = button.dataset.p238Category;
    limit = pageSize;
    render();
    library.scrollIntoView({block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth'});
  }));
  back.addEventListener('click', () => {
    category = '';
    limit = pageSize;
    render();
    view.querySelector('.p238-categories').scrollIntoView({block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth'});
  });
  more.addEventListener('click', () => {
    limit += pageSize;
    render();
  });

  function updateAccessibleLabels() {
    const suffix = document.documentElement.dataset.lang === 'zh' ? 'Zh' : 'En';
    view.querySelectorAll('img[data-p2314-image]').forEach(img => {
      img.alt = img.dataset['alt' + suffix];
      const button = img.closest('.photo-button');
      if (button) button.setAttribute('aria-label', button.dataset['label' + suffix]);
    });
  }
  new MutationObserver(updateAccessibleLabels).observe(document.documentElement, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['data-lang']
  });
  updateAccessibleLabels();
  render();
})();

    <div class="sustain-rail sustain-hero-copy">
      <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">Our sustainability approach</span><span class="zh">我们的可持续制造理念</span></p>
      <h1><span class="en">Made with the<br>
Future in Mind.</span><span class="zh">为更长远的未来而制造</span></h1>
      <p><span class="en">From material selection to finished garments, we pursue long-term improvement through thoughtful resource use, reliable quality and care for people.</span><span class="zh">从材料选择到成衣制造，以更审慎的资源使用、可靠的品质和对人的关怀，推动长期改善。</span></p>
    </div>
    <figure class="sustain-rail sustain-hero-art"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_724__" alt="Aerial rendering of the new Unitex factory campus" data-story-alt-zh="众智新厂园区鸟瞰效果图" width="1536" height="768" loading="lazy" decoding="async"><figcaption><span class="en">New factory rendering</span><span class="zh">新厂效果图</span></figcaption></figure>

    <section class="sustain-topic" id="sustainability-cleaner-energy" aria-labelledby="sustainability-cleaner-energy-title">
      <div class="sustain-topic-head">
        <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">01 / Energy</span><span class="zh">01 / 能源</span></p>
        <h2 id="sustainability-cleaner-energy-title"><span class="en">Cleaner energy</span><span class="zh">清洁能源</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="sustain-topic-body">
        <figure class="sustain-topic-media sustain-approved-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_729__" alt="Rooftop solar panels beside an elevated railway" data-story-alt-zh="高架铁路旁的屋顶光伏板" width="840" height="660" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
        <div class="sustain-topic-copy">
          <p><span class="en">Solar power and thoughtful energy use belong in the same conversation. Rooftop generation, efficient lighting and everyday operating habits shape our approach.</span><span class="zh">太阳能发电与审慎的能源使用相辅相成。屋顶光伏、高效照明和日常用能习惯都是我们关注的方向。</span></p>
          <ul class="sustain-topic-focus">
        <li><span class="en">Solar generation</span><span class="zh">太阳能发电</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Lighting</span><span class="zh">照明</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Energy awareness</span><span class="zh">用能意识</span></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="sustain-topic" id="sustainability-responsible-materials" aria-labelledby="sustainability-responsible-materials-title">
      <div class="sustain-topic-head">
        <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">02 / Materials</span><span class="zh">02 / 材料</span></p>
        <h2 id="sustainability-responsible-materials-title"><span class="en">Responsible materials</span><span class="zh">负责任的材料</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="sustain-topic-body">
        <figure class="sustain-topic-media sustain-approved-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_730__" alt="Operator examining striped fabric on a fabric inspection machine" data-story-alt-zh="操作员在验布机上检查条纹面料" width="840" height="601" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
        <div class="sustain-topic-copy">
          <p><span class="en">Consider the fabric before the garment. Explore organic and recycled options, align material choices with product needs and maintain clear supplier information.</span><span class="zh">从面料开始考虑成衣。探索有机及再生材料选项，按产品需求选材，并清晰记录供应商信息。</span></p>
          <ul class="sustain-topic-focus">
        <li><span class="en">Material options</span><span class="zh">材料选项</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Fabric inspection</span><span class="zh">面料检验</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Supplier information</span><span class="zh">供应商信息</span></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="sustain-topic" id="sustainability-resource-efficient-production" aria-labelledby="sustainability-resource-efficient-production-title">
      <div class="sustain-topic-head">
        <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">03 / Production</span><span class="zh">03 / 生产</span></p>
        <h2 id="sustainability-resource-efficient-production-title"><span class="en">Resource-efficient production</span><span class="zh">更有效地使用资源</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="sustain-topic-body">
        <figure class="sustain-topic-media sustain-approved-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_736__" alt="Concept illustration of an automated guided vehicle carrying cartons" data-story-alt-zh="自动导引车搬运纸箱的概念示意图" width="840" height="660" loading="lazy" decoding="async"><figcaption><span class="en">AGV material flow concept</span><span class="zh">AGV（自动导引车）物料流转概念示意</span></figcaption></figure>
        <div class="sustain-topic-copy">
          <p><span class="en">Connect fabric handling, precise cutting and garment flow. Well-planned processes help teams work with greater care for materials, movement and time.</span><span class="zh">将面料处理、精准裁剪与成衣流转衔接起来。通过合理安排工序，更有效地利用材料、减少搬运并节省时间。</span></p>
          <ul class="sustain-topic-focus">
        <li><span class="en">Automated cutting</span><span class="zh">自动裁剪</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Hanging systems</span><span class="zh">吊挂系统</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Material flow</span><span class="zh">物料流转</span></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
    <section class="sustain-topic" id="sustainability-water-chemical-stewardship" aria-labelledby="sustainability-water-chemical-stewardship-title">
      <div class="sustain-topic-head">
        <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">04 / Water &amp; chemicals</span><span class="zh">04 / 水与化学品</span></p>
        <h2 id="sustainability-water-chemical-stewardship-title"><span class="en">Water &amp; chemical stewardship</span><span class="zh">水与化学品管理</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="sustain-topic-body">
        <figure class="sustain-topic-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_731__" alt="Water treatment tank and sample containers" data-story-alt-zh="水处理池和装有水样的容器" width="1120" height="840" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></figure>
        <div class="sustain-topic-copy">
          <p><span class="en">Care for water through each stage. Water-saving fixtures, treatment processes and attention to material safety support a more considered production approach.</span><span class="zh">关注各生产环节的用水。将节水设施、水处理流程和材料安全纳入生产管理。</span></p>
          <ul class="sustain-topic-focus">
        <li><span class="en">Water use</span><span class="zh">用水</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Treatment stages</span><span class="zh">水处理流程</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Material safety</span><span class="zh">材料安全</span></li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sustain-topic-head">
        <p class="sustain-kicker"><span class="en">05 / Quality</span><span class="zh">05 / 品质</span></p>
        <h2 id="sustainability-quality-for-longer-use-title"><span class="en">Quality for longer use</span><span class="zh">品质与长期使用</span></h2>
      </div>
      <div class="sustain-topic-body">
        <div class="sustain-approved-quality"><figure class="sustain-topic-media sustain-approved-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_727__" alt="Optical system for measuring how fabric dimensions change after washing" data-story-alt-zh="测量面料水洗后尺寸变化的光学设备" width="840" height="435" loading="lazy" decoding="async"><figcaption><span class="en">Dimensional stability after washing</span><span class="zh">水洗后尺寸稳定性</span></figcaption></figure><figure class="sustain-topic-media sustain-approved-media"><img data-unitex-src="__UNITEX_ASSET_744__" alt="Automatic garment measurement system with a shirt laid flat" data-story-alt-zh="平铺上衣的自动成衣测量设备" width="840" height="222" loading="lazy" decoding="async"><figcaption><span class="en">Automatic garment measurement</span><span class="zh">自动成衣尺寸测量</span><span class="sustain-equipment-note"><span class="en">Visual concept · Equipment reference</span><span class="zh">概念示意 · 设备参考</span></span></figcaption></figure></div>
        <div class="sustain-topic-copy">
          <p><span class="en">Dimensional stability after washing helps assess shape retention. Digital garment measurement supports consistent sizing and traceable quality records.</span><span class="zh">水洗后尺寸稳定性有助于评估保形性。数字化成衣测量有助于保持尺码一致，并让质量记录可追溯。</span></p>
          <ul class="sustain-topic-focus">
        <li><span class="en">Shape retention</span><span class="zh">保形性</span></li>
        <li><span class="en">Dimensional stability</span><span class="zh">尺寸稳定性</span></li>

          </ul>
        </div>

(() => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const localized = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-story-alt-zh], [data-story-label-zh]')].map(node => {
    const attribute = node.hasAttribute('data-story-alt-zh') ? 'alt' : 'aria-label';
    return {
      node,
      attribute,
      en: node.getAttribute(attribute),
      zh: node.getAttribute(attribute === 'alt' ? 'data-story-alt-zh' : 'data-story-label-zh'),
    };
  });
  function localize() {
    const language = root.dataset.lang;
    for (const item of localized) item.node.setAttribute(item.attribute, item[language]);
    const route = document.querySelector('.k-route:not([hidden])');
    if (route && !root.dataset.offlineFactory) {
      const heading = route.querySelector('h1 .' + language);
      document.title = route.id === 'home'
        ? (language === 'zh' ? 'Unitex | 服装开发与全球制造' : 'Unitex | Apparel Development & Global Manufacturing')
        : 'Unitex | ' + (heading ? heading.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : 'Unitex');
    }
  }
  new MutationObserver(localize).observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-lang'] });
  localize();
})();
